t: The Pervert's Guide to Computer Programming Languages - SXSW

q.x: It has nothing to do with the language itself and everything to do with the user of the language. [1] The Pervert's Guide to Computer Programming Languages [link]

desc: What is the right programming language for you? Traditionally programming languages are created to concisely model a specific problem, or to maximize expression while solving a broad range of problems. Psychoanalysts have noted that many decisions we make as humans are not based on rational premises, but rather are based on fears and desires that stem from upbringing and our societal ideologies.

recs.x:
Everyone’s relationship to their tools of choice has an emotional component. Check out this talk, you might find it interesting:

“The Pervert’s Guide To Programming Languages”

I don’t think masochism is inherently negative and I did not mean to insult. For that I apologize. I was trying to characterize in a humorous fashion a difference between what I perceive to be the stated aims of the language and the experience of actually writing it.
